item.title: [data-breach] Cognizant’s TriZetto Provider Solutions data breach impacted over 3.4 million patients
item.description: A breach at Cognizant’s TriZetto Provider Solutions exposed sensitive health data belonging to more than 3.4 million patients. A data breach at Cognizant’s TriZetto Provider Solutions exposed sensitive information belonging to more than 3.4 million patients.
